team.title: Project team
team.inviteEmailHint: They get a link to create their organization's account and join the project
team.noUsersToAdd: Everyone in your organization is already in the project. Invite new users from "Organization users".
team.inviteNewHint: Joins your organization and this project with the chosen role and disciplines in one step.

invite.emailNotSent: Email is not set up on the server yet. Copy the link and send it to {{email}} yourself (WhatsApp or email).
invite.title: Invitation to Verqac
invite.toProject: {{inviter}} invites you to the project "{{project}}" as {{party}}.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired or was withdrawn.
invite.loginFirst: This email already has a Verqac account. Sign in with it first, then open the link again.
invite.otherEmail: You are signed in as {{email}}. Sign out and sign in as {{invited}}.

org.title: Organization users
org.hint: Once they accept, they belong to your organization; then add them to projects from the Team tab. Or invite them from a project team to join both at once.
org.suspendConfirm: Sign-in is closed and they leave every project of the organization. Their records and answers stay. After reactivating, add them to projects again from the team page.

rec.title: Subject
rec.filesHint: PDF of the materials or drawings. More files can be added before submitting.
rec.draftNote: Draft: the consultant and owner do not see it until it is submitted.
rec.commentRequired: Comments are required for this action
rec.noEngineer: No consultant engineer covers this discipline in the project team yet. On submission it reaches only the consultant's project manager.
rec.requiredByNote: Reason (e.g. delivery date in the supply schedule)
rec.requiredByHint: The latest date you need this approved, from the supply schedule, for critical items. The consultant sees it; it is not printed.
rec.notPrinted: Seen by the contractor and consultant only; not printed.
rec.addressedToHint: The consultant engineer this request goes to

settings.reviewHint: From the contract or quality plan, in days and hours: the consultant's reply period, and the contractor's period to submit the next revision after “revise and resubmit” or “rejected”. For inspections the reply period starts at submission, or at the requested inspection time if later. New periods apply to what is submitted or answered after saving.
settings.readOnly: Only the project manager can change these.
settings.notifyHint: Notifications inside the platform (bell and Awaiting me) always work. Choose whether they also go by e-mail or to the Mahami app.
settings.notOnServer: not set up on the server yet
settings.kindsHint: The list the contractor picks the submittal type from in this project. A renamed type changes everywhere. A type used by records cannot be deleted; switch it off instead, so it leaves the list for new requests and stays on old records.
settings.kindInactive: Off — not offered for new requests
settings.linkSubmittalsHint: The inspection form lists the stage's submittals to pick the ones it relies on, and warns when they are not approved.
settings.routingHint: The consultant PM always sees every request and can answer or reassign it.

routing.discipline: The consultant engineers of the discipline
routing.manager: The consultant PM, who assigns it

settings.checklistsHint: The supervising engineer answers the checklist of the request's topic; it is printed with the reply. Edit the lists under the stage topics.
settings.remindersHint: Reminds whoever must reply before the deadline (a day for submittals, 30 minutes for inspections) and when it is overdue, and the contractor before and after the resubmission deadline. Overdue submittals are reminded daily.
settings.typesHint: Switch on only what this project uses; only those tabs show. Existing requests are kept when a type is switched off.

resp.title: Consultant's comments
resp.placeholder: Write the comments, one per line…
resp.hint: Saved with the decision and shown on the record and the PDF. The draft is kept on this device until you choose a decision.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.blocked: The browser blocks notifications for this site; allow them from the lock icon next to the address.
bell.whileOpen: Works while Verqac is open in a tab, even minimized or behind other windows.
bell.pushHint: Turn on desktop notifications to get them with a sound even when Verqac is closed, as long as the browser runs on this device.
bell.pushOn: On for this device: notifications arrive with a sound and stay on screen until closed, even when Verqac is closed.

verify.title: Verify a consultant reply
verify.okHint: This reply was issued on Verqac, and its data, files and the consultant's decision match exactly what is stored. Compare the details below with the paper in your hands.
verify.changed: ✗ The stored data no longer matches the stamp
verify.changedHint: The stamp exists, but the stored reply changed after it was issued. Do not rely on this paper; contact the consultant.
verify.newer: A newer revision of this request exists: R{{rev}} — status: {{state}}. Make sure you work from the latest revision.
verify.cancelled: This request was cancelled after it was answered.
verify.notFoundHint: No reply on the platform has this stamp. The paper may not come from the platform, or it was copied incorrectly.
verify.subject: Subject

structure.wholeStageHint: This stage is done for the whole project, so the request covers all of it.
structure.inactive: Off — not offered for new requests
structure.usedHint: Used by requests: switch it off instead of deleting.
structure.applyHint: Pick the project type to copy its stages and locations from the template, then adjust them here.
structure.stagesHint: Work stages and their weight in progress (active ones total 100%). Requests pick a stage now; inspections will later.
structure.locationsHint: Where work happens. A request covers one or more of them, or the whole project.
structure.typesHint: A template per type: stages, weights and default locations. Copied into a project when it is created; editing a template leaves existing projects as they are.
structure.noneYet: This project has no stages or locations yet. The contractor's project manager sets them in the Settings tab.
structure.noneYetEditor: This project has no stages or locations yet. In the Settings tab pick the project type and press “Apply template”; the stage and floor fields then appear here.

account.title: My account
account.forgotHint: Enter your e-mail and we'll send a link to set a new password, valid for one hour.
account.linkSent: If the e-mail is registered, the link arrives within minutes. Check the spam folder too.
account.noMail: E-mail sending is not set up on the platform yet. Ask your organization admin for a reset link from Organization settings.
account.resetExpired: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.
account.resetDone: Your new password is set. Sign in with it; sessions on other devices were closed.
account.language: Language of the interface and notifications
account.otherDevices: After the change, your sessions on other devices are closed.
account.resetLinkHint: Send this link to the employee (WhatsApp, say). One use only, valid until {{date}}; nobody else sees it.
account.resetLinkEmailed: It was also e-mailed to them.

header.title: Project letterhead (logos)
header.hint: One wide image with the logos of the owner, consultant, contractor and others, printed at the top of the project's papers. Suggested size: 2000–2500 px wide, 250–400 px high, PNG on white, up to 5 MB.
header.none: No letterhead yet. Papers print the contractor's name.

resubmit.hint: The consultant asked for a new revision. Create a “New revision” and submit it by this date; submitting it closes this deadline.

ir.linkedHint: Material submittals this work relies on
ir.noApprovedInStage: No approved submittal for this stage's materials.
ir.linkNotApproved: Some of the chosen submittals are not approved yet.
ir.noLink: This inspection is not linked to any material submittal.

checklist.title: Inspection checklist
checklist.hint: The list is fixed into an inspection request when it is submitted, so later edits do not change submitted requests. Save the stages after editing.
checklist.preview: The items the supervising engineer will check.

cal.orgHint: Weekly days off and official holidays are not counted in reply and resubmission periods in all the organization's projects. Changes apply to requests submitted afterwards.
cal.name: Occasion
cal.projectHint: Reply and resubmission periods count working days: weekly days off, official holidays and project holidays are skipped.
cal.workHoursHint: For periods in hours (such as inspections) only working hours count: a request after closing time starts counting the next working morning.
cal.noOrgHolidays: No official holidays in the organization calendar yet (Organization settings → Calendar & holidays).

rfi.requiredByHint: The latest date you need the answer so the work is not held up. The consultant sees it; it is not printed.

lab.title: Laboratory test results
lab.noClasses: Define the concrete classes in the project settings
lab.conflict: The lab conclusion ({{lab}}) differs from the result calculated on the project criteria — check the limits.
lab.aiTitle: Read the lab certificate with AI
lab.aiHint: Attach the lab report (PDF), then pick it here: the values are read and shown for review next to the file before saving.
lab.reviewTitle: Review the values read from the lab certificate
lab.reviewHint: Compare with the file and correct what is needed. Nothing is saved before "Apply".
lab.unsureCount: {{count}} value(s) not clearly legible (highlighted) — check them.

match.grade: Class {{grade}} found from the certificate grade
match.topic: Class {{grade}} found from the request topic
match.strength: Class {{grade}} found from the specified strength
match.only: Class {{grade}} is the only class of the project
match.none: No concrete class found — choose one

lab.classHint: Left empty, it is found from the certificate or the request topic when read
lab.gradeUnknown: The certificate grade "{{grade}}" is not a concrete class of the project — add it in the project settings (or as another name of a class) before applying, or it is judged on another class.
lab.strengthDiff: The certificate states {{grade}} = {{cert}} MPa, but the strength used is {{fck}} MPa — check the class.
lab.certsHint: Pick this test's certificate. Read the others into their own tests from the same file.

labt.hint: Test templates used in all the organization's projects: parameters, units, test methods and acceptance limits. A new test takes its template; limits can be adjusted on the test.
labt.samplesHint: e.g. Ø32,Ø25 — parameters repeat per sample
labt.concreteHint: Cube lines are generated when the test is created from the number of specimens; the minimum comes from the project concrete class.

cc.title: Concrete classes of the project
cc.hint: Grades used and how their cubes are accepted per the contract specification: mean ≥ fck + margin, each specimen ≥ fck − margin (or a % of fck). Link a class to stage topics so the criteria follow the element tested.

daily.title: Daily report
daily.copyHint: Copies crew and equipment; the previous report’s plan for tomorrow becomes today’s work list.
daily.crewHint: How staff are recorded (names or counts) and the suggested lists come from the project settings.
daily.worksHint: For each work: stage, topic and location. Progress is optional and cumulative for the cell (stage × floor); weekly is enough. It counts once supervision approves the report.
daily.mirCreated: Material inspection created as a draft — save the report.
daily.plannedHint: Works planned for tomorrow; they become tomorrow’s work list.
daily.qaHint: Automatic from the project registers: what was submitted and answered that day.
daily.qaNone: Nothing in the QA registers that day.

progress.asOf: As of the latest approved report, {{date}}
progress.hint: From approved daily reports only, weighted by the stage weights. A cell = the stage at a floor.
progress.noStages: Define the project stages in the settings first.

dset.title: Daily report
dset.hint: How staff are recorded in the daily report, and the suggested lists in both languages. A choice from the list shows in the reader’s language in the report and the printout; a name not in the list can still be typed.
dset.linkMaterials: Link delivered materials to their approvals
dset.linkMaterialsHint: The materials section picks the material approval and can create a material inspection in one click.

listHint.supervision_names: Supervision staff and positions, e.g. Eng. Sami Dawood — Civil engineer.
listHint.supervision_desc: Supervision positions, e.g. civil engineer, inspector.
listHint.contractor_names: Contractor staff and positions, e.g. Eng. Said Aloush — Site engineer.
listHint.contractor_desc: Contractor positions, e.g. site engineer, foreman, surveyor.
listHint.labour_desc: Labour trades, e.g. steel fixer, carpenter, labourer.
listHint.equipment: Equipment used, e.g. tower crane, concrete pump.

dset.positions: Positions (chosen above, and used in the count mode)
